name: Sweep all budgeted UI interaction flows (continuous perf cadence)
description: Run the out-of-band per-flow capture cadence for a scenario: for each interaction flow with a per-flow budget declared, drive a targeted audit, analyze the trace, persist a flow-tagged trend sample, and report the per-flow budget verdict. Gating is continuous — a regression on a budgeted journey fails the next `git-control-tower baseline diff`, NOT this call and NOT the synchronous Performance phase.

scenario.description: Scenario slug whose budgeted flows to sweep.

results.description: JSON of per-flow sweep results (outcome, within_budget, violations).

examples.description: Sweep every budgeted interaction flow for image-tools.
